description: v0.8 Galapagos run flow: user asks the assistant to start the optimizer for 50 generations. The tool returns status=manual_start_required (Galapagos cannot be driven headlessly) and the assistant closes the turn by instructing the user to press Start in the Galapagos Editor manually. Exercises the gh_galapagos_run tool shape and the manual-start fallback contract.
userPrompt: Ok, start the optimization for 50 generations.

interactions.text: Requesting a 50-generation run from the Galapagos runner.
Galapagos cannot be started headlessly, so you need to press Start in the Galapagos Editor manually. Your 50-generation cap and population of 50 have been staged.

result.message: Galapagos requires manual Start click in the Editor.
